channel.title: Wire — Cloud
channel.description: Cloud from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: OpenAI GPT-6.1 Terra is now generally available on Amazon Bedrock
item.description: Today, AWS announces the general availability of OpenAI GPT-6.1 Terra on Amazon Bedrock. GPT-6.1 Terra expands the GPT-6 family with a balance of capability, speed, and cost efficiency for everyday workloads. (2 sources: aws, hackernews)

item.title: AWS Shows Use of AI Agents to Triage Linux Kernel CVEs
item.description: Engineers from Amazon Web Services (AWS) have described how the team that maintains the Linux kernel for EC2 infrastructure handles kernel CVEs. The process combines an automated filter, an AI agent and human review. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Cloudflare and VoidZero Introduce tsrs: An AI-Generated Rust Port of TypeScript
item.description: Cloudflare, VoidZero and Max Schwenk announced tsrs, an experimental Rust port of the TypeScript compiler, built with the TypeScript team's involvement. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Amazon WorkSpaces Core Managed Instances now supports ModifyVolume API
item.description: Amazon WorkSpaces Core Managed Instances now supports the ModifyVolume API, which lets you change volume size, volume type, IOPS, or throughput in place, without detaching the volume or restarting the instance. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon SageMaker Unified Studio adds light mode support for IDC-based domains
item.description: Today, AWS announces light mode support in Amazon SageMaker Unified Studio for Identity Center (IDC) based domains. Customers can now configure the visual interface mode to match their preference, choosing between dark and light themes. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon Connect Customer expands testing and simulation to validate flow action outcomes
item.description: Amazon Connect Customer now enables you to validate the outcomes of your customer experience flow actions during testing and simulation. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon Connect Customer now lets you view metrics by customer lifetime value and repeat-caller status
item.description: Now you can view your metrics across customer segments: customer lifetime value (LTV) and repeat callers. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon Connect Customer now measures the outcomes that drive retention and revenue
item.description: Amazon Connect Customer now scores the outcome of your customer interactions. It shows whether the customer left satisfied, is at risk of churning, made a purchase, or resolved their need in self-service. (1 source: aws)
